text:
Ava: Idea: 30m practical webinar for product + infra teams. hook: 'Ship lower-cost inference this sprint' — want action not theory.
Theo: love it. format idea: 5m framing, 15m demo playbook, 5m checklist, 5m Q&A. tight and ship-focused.
Noor: volunteer to host checklist & CTAs. Theo you can run demo?
Theo: yep. will show baseline -> batching -> cache -> cheap-model routing. each step: one slide + one command + metric.
Sam: marketing will own landing page copy + social CTAs. Ill draft 3 headline options and 2 CTA variants by EOD.
Ava: rehearsal plan: tech check (30m) + full run (40m). windows Tue 09:30 PT, Thu 16:00 PT. Preferred Tue for tech check.
PromoBot: Rehearsal created: Tue 09:30 PT (tech check) and Thu 16:00 PT (full run). Attendees: Ava, Theo, Noor, Sam. Link: https://events.redwood.example/rec_zzz
Theo: demo ask: pin model version and fallback to quantized variant. will upload demo notebook + a 90s fallback clip. snippet I'll use: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-2b","input":"hello"}'`
Noor: I'll make the presenter cue cards and a one-page downloadable checklist. can we include a quick opt-in CTA: "Request a free cost audit"?
Sam: yes, include audit CTA in follow-up. follow-up plan: recording + checklist + audit CTA. I'll also prepare social microcopy for LinkedIn + X.
Ava: run-of-show draft:
`0:00-0:45 Intro & goals (Ava)`
`0:45-6:00 Demo customer hook (pre-recorded or quick mention)`
`6:00-21:00 Demo playbook (Theo)`
`21:00-26:00 Ops checklist & downloads (Noor)`
`26:00-30:00 Q&A + poll (All)`
Theo: uploading artifacts to drive now. link when ready.
Ava: next steps: Sam posts headlines, Theo uploads notebook + fallback, Noor drafts cue cards. Reconvene at tech check. :rocket:
